title: Flexible competency framework: A tool for optimizing life science training
content:
by Xiuqi Li, Jelena Patrnogić, David Van Vactor

As life sciences research evolves, standards of rigor and professionalism remain essential. We present a flexible competency-based framework designed to align program objectives, curricula, and mentoring expectations, thereby enhancing trainee skill development and program adaptability.
author: Xiuqi Li
